premises.text: B2B shipping involves complex logistics with multiple transport providers and local partners
premises.evidence_span: if you switch to the industrial B2B world, things are much more complex. Imagine you are the head of operations for an automotive manufacturer. You need to ship spare parts from China to the U.S. You ask one of your transport providers, who will then outsource to a local Chinese trucker, then a shipping line, then a U.S. trucker, and then a customer expert.

premises.text: Data in multimodal freight is highly fragmented and relies on legacy systems
premises.evidence_span: In the world of multimodal freight, data is highly fragmented. And this is a bad dream turned into a nightmare, because transport providers rely on legacy systems, producing unreliable information.

premises.text: Industrial shippers struggle to track goods and predict arrival times, leading to significant financial losses
premises.evidence_span: Industrial shippers struggle to answer two key questions, which are crucial for the bottom line. Where are the goods? And when will they arrive at the destination? When they face a 10-day delay, and they need to stop the production line, they lose several million euros.

premises.text: Weikio provides real-time visibility on B2B transport flows across multiple modes of transport
premises.evidence_span: Weikio is a SaaS platform bringing real-time visibility on B2B transport flows across sea, air, and road.

premises.text: Consolidation of transport providers improves data quality and tracking reliability
premises.evidence_span: Our platform consolidates all transport providers, including shipping lines, airlines, and forwarders, using API and EDI connections.

premises.text: Data science can predict arrival times by considering external factors
premises.evidence_span: we use data science to predict times of arrival by taking into account external factors like real-time traffic or events.

premises.text: Weikio enhances customer experience by providing proactive information
premises.evidence_span: we improve customer experience by providing proactive information to the end customer.

premises.text: Weikio targets the multimodal overseas shipment market, which is complementary to existing freight services
premises.evidence_span: We focus on multimodal overseas shipments. Some players talk about being multimodal, but we have a unique tech to guarantee data quality and predictability for international shipments.

value.text: Weikio enables efficient and predictable B2B shipping, reducing costs and improving operational reliability
value.evidence_span: reliability, to reduce safety inventories and save up to several million euros a year.

notes: Traction metrics and personal backgrounds are excluded as they do not constitute premises.
